arxiv-1811-02767.title: Geometry of C ​ R ​ S CRS bi-warped product submanifolds in Sasakian and cosymplectic manifolds
arxiv-1811-02767.creator: Bang-Yen Chen, Siraj Uddin, Azeb Alghanemi, Awatif Al-Jedani, Ion Mihai
arxiv-1811-02767.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Bang-Yen Chen, Siraj Uddin, Azeb Alghanemi, Awatif Al-Jedani, Ion Mihai. In this paper, we prove that there are no proper C ​ R ​ S CRS bi-warped product submanifolds other than contact CR-biwarped products in Sasakian manifolds.

arxiv-2001-09540.title: Weakly Supervised Few-shot Object Segmentation using Co-Attention with Visual and Semantic Embeddings
arxiv-2001-09540.creator: Mennatullah Siam, Naren Doraiswamy, Boris N. Oreshkin, Hengshuai Yao, Martin Jagersand
arxiv-2001-09540.description: Abstract Significant progress has been made recently in developing few-shot object segmentation methods. Learning is shown to be successful in few-shot segmentation settings, using pixel-level, scribbles and bounding box supervision. This paper takes another approach, i.e., only requiring image-level label for few-shot object segmentation.

arxiv-2111-07922.title: A kiloelectron-volt ultrafast electron micro-diffraction apparatus using low emittance semiconductor photocathodes
arxiv-2111-07922.creator: W. H. Li, C. J. R. Duncan, M. B. Andorf, A. C. Bartnik, E. Bianco, L. Cultrera, A. Galdi, M. Gordon, M. Kaemingk, C. A. Pennington, L. F. Kourkoutis, I. V. Bazarov, J. M. Maxson
arxiv-2111-07922.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by W. H. Li, C. J. R. Duncan, M. B. Andorf, A. C. Bartnik, E. Bianco, L. Cultrera, A. Galdi, M. Gordon, M. Kaemingk, C. A. Pennington, L. F. Kourkoutis, I. V. Bazarov, J. M. Maxson. We report the design and performance of a time-resolved electron diffraction apparatus capable of producing intense bunches with simultaneously single digit micron probe size, long coherence length, and 200 200 fs rms time resolution.

arxiv-2203-10300.title: Analyzing speaker verification embedding extractors and back-ends under language and channel mismatch
arxiv-2203-10300.description: Abstract In this paper, we analyze the behavior and performance of speaker embeddings and the back-end scoring model under domain and language mismatch. We present our findings regarding ResNet-based speaker embedding architectures and show that reduced temporal stride yields improved performance.

arxiv-2211-04713.title: Triply charmed baryons mass decomposition from lattice QCD
arxiv-2211-04713.creator: Jin-Bo Li, Long-Cheng Gui, Wei Sun, Jian Liang, Wen Qin
arxiv-2211-04713.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jin-Bo Li, Long-Cheng Gui, Wei Sun, Jian Liang, Wen Qin. We present the first calculation of the connected scalar matrix element and the momentum fraction of charm quark within the 3 2 + \frac{3}{2}^{+} and 3 2 − \frac{3}{2}^{-} triply charmed baryons on lattice QCD. The results are based on overlap valence fermions on two ensembles of N f = 2 + 1 N_{f}=2+1 domain wall fermion configurations with two lattice spacings.

arxiv-2211-07802.title: The Two-Color Ext Soergel Calculus
arxiv-2211-07802.creator: or: The Ext-Dihedral Cathedral
arxiv-2211-07802.description: Abstract We compute Ext groups between Soergel Bimodules associated to the infinite/finite dihedral group for a realization in characteristic 0 and show that they are free right R − R- modules. In particular, we obtain an explicit diagrammatic basis for the Hochschild cohomology of indecomposable Soergel Bimodules.

arxiv-2302-09953.title: Personalized speech enhancement combining band-split RNN and speaker attentive module
arxiv-2302-09953.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by . Target speaker information can be utilized in speech enhancement (SE) models to more effectively extract the desired speech. Previous works introduce the speaker embedding into speech enhancement models by means of concatenation or affine transformation. In this paper, we propose a speaker attentive module to calculate the attention scores between the speaker embedding and the intermediate features, which are used to rescale the features.

arxiv-2305-01851.title: Complexity and Enumeration in Models of Genome Rearrangement Thanks: We wish to thank the American Mathematical Society for organizing the Mathematics Research Community workshop where this work began. This material is based upon work supported by the National Science Foundation under Grant Number D
arxiv-2305-01851.creator: Lora Bailey, Heather Smith Blake, Garner Cochran, Nathan Fox, Michael Levet ∗, Reem Mahmoud, Elizabeth Bailey Matson, Inne Singgih, Grace Stadnyk, Xinyi Wang, Alexander Wiedemann
arxiv-2305-01851.description: Abstract . In this paper, we examine the computational complexity of enumeration in certain genome rearrangement models. We first show that the Pairwise Rearrangement problem in the Single Cut-and-Join model (Bergeron, Medvedev, & Stoye, J. Comput. Biol. 2010) is # ​ P \#\textsf{P} -complete under polynomial-time Turing reductions.

arxiv-2309-10109.title: AR-TTA: A Simple Method for Real-World Continual Test-Time Adaptation
arxiv-2309-10109.creator: Damian Sójka, Bartłomiej Twardowski, Tomasz Trzciński, Sebastian Cygert
arxiv-2309-10109.description: Abstract Test-time adaptation is a promising research direction that allows the source model to adapt itself to changes in data distribution without any supervision. Yet, current methods are usually evaluated on benchmarks that are only a simplification of real-world scenarios. Hence, we propose to validate test-time adaptation methods using the recently introduced datasets for autonomous driving, namely CLAD-C and SHIFT.

arxiv-2401-02761.title: Investigation of hidden symmetry in A ​ d ​ S 5 AdS_{5} black hole with Heun equation
arxiv-2401-02761.description: Abstract Investigating the existence of algebra and finding hidden symmetries in physical systems is one of the most important aspects for understanding their behavior and predicting their future. Expanding this unique method of study to cosmic structures and combining past knowledge with new data can be very interesting and lead to discovering new ways to analyze these systems.

arxiv-2405-06817.title: Coherent Design of Wind Turbine Controllers Considering Transitions between Operating Regions using Fuzzy Membership Functions
arxiv-2405-06817.creator: Horst Schulte
arxiv-2405-06817.description: Abstract This paper presents a coherent design of wind turbine controllers with explicit consideration of transitions between operating regions by fuzzy membership functions. In improving the design process of wind turbines, the transitions between partial-load operation by torque control and full-load operation by pitch control need to be systematically considered.

arxiv-2501-11153.title: Efficient Frame Extraction: A Novel Approach Through Frame Similarity and Surgical Tool Tracking for Video Segmentation
arxiv-2501-11153.creator: HUU PHONG NGUYEN 1, SHEKHAR MADHAV KHAIRNAR 1, SOFIA GARCES PALACIOS 1, AMR AL-ABBAS 1, MELISSA E. HOGG 2, AMER H. ZUREIKAT 3, PATRICIO M. POLANCO 1, HERBERT ZEH III 1, GANESH SANKARANARAYANAN 1
arxiv-2501-11153.description: Abstract The interest in leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) for surgical procedures to automate analysis has witnessed a significant surge in recent years. One of the primary tools for recording surgical procedures and conducting subsequent analyses, such as performance assessment, is through videos.

arxiv-2505-14855.title: Neural Heterogeneity Enables Adaptive Encoding of Time Sequences
arxiv-2505-14855.creator: Raphael Lafond-Mercier, Leonard Maler, Avner Wallach, André Longtin
arxiv-2505-14855.description: Abstract Biological systems represent time from microseconds to years. An important gap in our knowledge concerns the mechanisms for encoding time intervals of hundreds of milliseconds to minutes that matter for tasks like navigation, communication, storage, recall, and prediction of stimulus patterns. A recently identified mechanism in fish thalamic neurons addresses this gap.

arxiv-2602-08418.title: Grover adaptive search with problem-specific state preparation Thanks: QUTAC: info@qutac.de
arxiv-2602-08418.creator: Maximilian Hess, Lilly Palackal, Abhishek Awasthi, Peter J. Eder, Manuel Schnaus, Laurin Demmler, Karen Wintersperger, Joseph Doetsch
arxiv-2602-08418.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Maximilian Hess, Lilly Palackal, Abhishek Awasthi, Peter J. Eder, Manuel Schnaus, Laurin Demmler, Karen Wintersperger, Joseph Doetsch. Grover’s search algorithm is one of the basic building block in the world of quantum algorithms. Successfully applying it to combinatorial optimization problems is a subtle challenge. As a quadratic speedup is not enough to naively search an exponentially large space, the search has to be complemented with a state preparation routine which increases the amplitudes of promising states by exploiting the problem structure.

arxiv-2604-07989.title: Show Me the Infographic I Imagine: Intent-Aware Infographic Retrieval for Authoring Support
arxiv-2604-07989.creator: Jing Xu, Jiarui Hu, Zhihao Shuai, Yiyun Chen, and Weikai Yang

pmc-11516712.title: Health Impact Assessment (HIA): a tool to drive health in all policies?
pmc-11516712.creator: L Green
pmc-11516712.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Health Impact Assessment (HIA) is often promoted as a tool to implement ‘health in all policies’ and sustainable development approaches to improve health and equity outcomes. However, is this truly the case? Currently global HIA practice is variable. This paper shares learning from the development and implementation of HIA in Wales to date to understand how HIA has been, and can be, used to inform policies and decisions and reduce health inequalities.

pmc-12709164.title: Synergistic design of an NiCo@BC–MOF derivative for enhanced energy storage and photocatalytic applications
pmc-12709164.creator: Malaika Arshad, Zia Ul Haq Khan, Maryam Zahid, Mahmood M. S. Abdullah
pmc-12709164.description: Next-generation energy storage systems demand the development of advanced functional materials. This study synthesizes an NiCo@BC–MOF derivative via a hydrothermal route using a 2,5-dihydroxyterephthalic acid ligand. This emerging approach reduces the MOF intrinsic conductivity and enhances structural stability due to synergistic MOF and biochar interactions. The prepared NiCo@BC–MOF exhibited a specific capacitance of 444.44 F g−1 at 0.

pmc-12830860.title: Pulsed 980 nm near-infrared photobiomodulation attenuates OVA-induced allergic asthma by modulating Th2 cytokine responses and inflammatory cell infiltration
pmc-12830860.creator: Zhengyi Wu, Jia Zhang, Qingxiang Gao, Detian Wang, Yiping Zhao, Hong Yu, Shih-Chin Cheng
pmc-12830860.description: Photobiomodulation (PBM) is a non-invasive therapeutic strategy that uses specific light wavelengths to stimulate cellular processes that promote tissue repair, reduce inflammation, and alleviate pain. In this study, we evaluated the efficacy of a high-intensity 980 nm near-infrared (NIR) pulsed laser in a murine model of ovalbumin (OVA)-induced allergic asthma.

pmc-13169495.title: Age‐Associated Impairment of Paneth Cells Driven by microRNA‐152 Promotes Intestinal Epithelial Vulnerability to Pathological Stress
pmc-13169495.creator: Bridgette Warner, Haonan Zhao, Hongxia Chen, Amy VanderStoep, Ana S G Cunningham, Dongyoon Yoo, Hee K Chung, Christine Brantner, Jennifer Coleman, Joungil Choi, Rosemary Kozar, Myriam Gorospe, Jian‐Ying Wang, Lan Xiao
pmc-13169495.description: Advanced age is a well‐known risk factor for severe complications in surgical patients with critical illnesses, partly due to declined intestinal mucosal defense, but the underlying mechanism remains largely unknown. Our study provided direct evidence from older human and mouse small intestines of the adverse impact of aging on Paneth cell functionality by impaired mitochondrial metabolism.

pmc-13627126.title: Tracing the patterns of HIV-1 transmission among people with different diagnosis status in Greece
pmc-13627126.creator: Evangelia Georgia Kostaki, Stefanos Limnaios, Georgios Adamis, Georgios Xylomenos, Maria Chini, Nikos Mangafas, Marios Lazanas, Stavros Patrinos, Simeon Metallidis, Olga Tsachouridou, Vasileios Papastamopoulos, Dimitrios Chatzidimitriou, Anastasia Antoniadou, Antonios Papadopoulos, Konstantinos Prot
pmc-13627126.description: Highlights•Late HIV presenters are a major source of onward transmission in Greece.•Recently diagnosed cases seeded few onward transmissions despite being the largest group.•Consistent findings across subtypes A1 and B and two late-presentation definitions.•Modified statistical phylogeography traced HIV transmission sources.•Earlier HIV testing and diagnosis is of major importance to interrupt transmission. Introduction HIV remains a persistent global public health problem (https://www.who.int/).

pmc-13678719.title: Curcumin-loaded alkali-heat-treated titanium modulates macrophage inflammatory responses
pmc-13678719.creator: Andrew Cedillo, Niloufar Abedi, Sahar Vahabzadeh, Miya Kang
pmc-13678719.description: Chronic inflammation at the implant–tissue interface is a major contributor to implant failure. Therefore, enhancing the biological response of titanium (Ti) surfaces is critical for promoting early osseointegration and improving long-term implant stability. In this study, alkali-heat-treated (AHT) Ti was evaluated as a platform for the controlled delivery of curcumin (Cur), a natural anti-inflammatory compound.

uslaw-usc-t26-s7401.title: 26 U.S.C. § 7401 — Authorization
uslaw-usc-t26-s7401.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t26-s7401.description: United States Code, Title 26 (Internal Revenue Code); Chapter 76 (Judicial Proceedings); Subchapter A (Civil Actions By The United States). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. No civil action for the collection or recovery of taxes, or of any fine, penalty, or forfeiture, shall be commenced unless the Secretary authorizes or sanctions the proceedings and the Attorney General or his delegate directs that.

uslaw-usc-t7-s4537.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t7-s4537.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 76 (Dairy Research And Promotion); Subchapter II (Dairy Research Program). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Termination or suspension of order The Secretary, whenever the Secretary finds that the order issued under this subchapter or any provision of such order obstructs or does not tend to facilitate the expansion of markets for milk and dairy.
